note 2 overlapping conductor shape(s) were merged into 1 — copper that overlaps on one level is one conductor, in 3D as in the planar model.
note Port 1 ('1') at (0, -11.65 mm) was taken to be on the conductor's low-y (bottom) end (the port's own direction), driving current in the +y direction, at 50 Ω.
note Port 1 at its line's end is a vertical lumped sheet 1680 µm (1.68 mm) wide and 762 µm (0.762 mm) tall from 'Top Copper (1 oz)' down to 'Bottom Copper (1 oz)' (the air box's floor): the nearest ground-reference plane with metal under the port.
note The air box's default padding is 12.9221 mm on every face — λ/4 at 5.8 GHz, the sweep's lowest frequency, since a radiation pattern is asked for — because a radiation pattern was asked for: its equivalence surface sits inside the absorber with room to spare around the structure. The setup names no pattern frequency, so the sweep's lowest stands in for it; state one to size the box for it. A padding the setup's AirBox states is used as stated.
note The air box's floor is 'Bottom Copper (1 oz)' as a PEC plane at 35 µm: it is the lowest ground-reference conductor, nothing is drawn on it and nothing is drawn below it.
